sheets.prompt: Surface design sheet for a science fiction exploration game, the planted beds of terraced tea gardens and a small homestead garden: dark tilled soil raked in straight furrows, low rows of seedlings and tea bushes as small rounded tufts in tidy lines, a few bare patches of drier, paler earth, scattered pebbles each with a tiny shadow, narrow footpaths of trodden earth between the beds, crisp pale stone kerbs edging each bed, a little wet darkness along an irrigation runnel. Three panels side by side: a large swatch of a bed seen from above at close range; stepped terraces of these beds seen from a walker's height with a small figure and a watering can for scale; a strip showing the marks simplifying with distance, rows and kerbs staying, furrows and pebbles gone far, flat colour far. Calm, tidy, flat colour dominant, marks sparse and fine. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, umber, olive, sage green and cream stone, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, photo texture, text, watermark, lettering, labels, flowers, vegetables, fruit, people, tools.
